description: A shell script snippet intended for inclusion in other scripts, providing setup functions and environment configurations for Git operations.

methods.name: set_reflog_action
methods.description: Sets the GIT_REFLOG_ACTION environment variable if not already set, to record the current action in reflog.

methods.name: git_editor
methods.description: Determines and executes the configured Git editor.

methods.name: git_pager
methods.description: Determines and executes the configured Git pager.

methods.name: is_bare_repository
methods.description: Checks if the current repository is bare.

methods.name: cd_to_toplevel
methods.description: Changes directory to the top-level of the Git working tree.

methods.name: require_work_tree_exists
methods.description: Ensures the current repository has a working tree.

methods.name: require_work_tree
methods.description: Ensures the current directory is inside a Git working tree.

methods.name: require_clean_work_tree
methods.description: Verifies that the working tree and index are clean, otherwise exits.

methods.name: pick_ident_script
methods.description: Generates a sed script to parse author/committer identities from a commit.

methods.name: parse_ident_from_commit
methods.description: Uses sed to parse identities from commit data.

methods.name: get_author_ident_from_commit
methods.description: Extracts author identity information from a specific commit.

methods.name: create_virtual_base
methods.description: Creates a virtual base file for merging two files using git apply.

methods.name: git_dir_init
methods.description: Initializes the Git directory environment, ensuring the script runs within a valid Git repository.

methods.name: peel_committish
methods.description: Verifies and resolves a commit reference.
